name: MediaAgentAI
author: trafficwatchdog

sections.description:
MediaAgentAI is a service that writes blog articles tailored to your shop or website,
together with social media posts. This plugin is the bridge between your site and the
service: it starts the service for your site and, if you choose so, lets it publish the
articles you approve, with the meta description stored where your SEO plugin keeps it.

The plugin itself does not generate content, does not create or remove user accounts or
application passwords, and does not add anything to the public side of your site.

What the plugin does

  • starts the service for your site with a single click – no account and no password are needed, and the materials wait in MediaAgentAI Studio,
  • takes you straight to the Studio, where the free sample materials appear as soon as they are ready, and shows their progress on the plugin screen too,
  • optionally connects an account and an application password that you create yourself, so that the service can publish the articles you approve,
  • checks that such an account has the rights of the Author role and no more – accounts that can edit the content of other users or administer the site are refused,
  • exposes the SEO fields of your SEO plugin (Yoast, Rank Math, SEOPress, All in One SEO) in the REST API so that the meta description can be saved,
  • shows in the admin screen what has been sent, and lets you disconnect the site with a single button.

With publishing connected, the service only publishes its own posts, with their images and
tags, in your existing categories. It never manages plugins, themes, users or settings of
your site. To match the articles to your site, it reads the published posts and pages of the
site, and on a shop the products from the public WooCommerce Store API.

External services

This plugin connects to the MediaAgentAI service (https://mediaagent.studio) in order to
register the site, prepare materials for it and, if you connect an account, publish articles on it.

When you start, the plugin sends: the site address, the REST API address, the address of the
plugin screen, the e-mail address of the site administrator, your acceptance of the Terms of
Service and the Privacy Policy together with the IP address of the administrator who accepted
them, a one-time confirmation code, the WordPress and PHP versions, whether WooCommerce is
installed, the name of the active SEO plugin, the category permalink base, and the names and
identifiers of the post categories. The exact list is shown in the plugin screen afterwards.

To make sure that the request came from your site, the service sends the confirmation code back
to a REST API route that the plugin adds: /wp-json/twd-mediaagent/v1/verify. The route answers
only whether the code was issued by this site in the last 10 minutes, and every code works once.

On a site without WooCommerce the service then reads the published pages and stores their text,
because the articles are based on them. If they do not describe the offer, the service visits the
public pages of the site, the way a search engine does, to find the offer.

While the sample materials are being prepared and the plugin screen is open, the plugin asks the
service about their progress every 10 seconds, sending the installation identifier and the site
address.

If you connect an account for publishing, the plugin also sends its username and the application
password that you entered. The plugin does not store the application password.

When you disconnect the site, or deactivate the plugin while the site is connected, the
plugin sends the installation identifier and the site address. The service then stops working
for the site and deletes the application password, if there was one, from its servers. The
application password itself stays in WordPress – revoking it is up to you.

Nothing is sent until the site administrator clicks the button – activating the plugin sends nothing.

Terms of service: https://trafficwatchdog.pl/en/docs/terms-of-service
Privacy policy: https://trafficwatchdog.pl/en/docs/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Open Media Agent AI in the admin menu (or click “Settings” next to the plugin on the Plugins screen).
  3. Accept the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy, and click “Generate free materials”. The plugin takes you to Media Agent AI Studio, where the materials appear as soon as they are ready.
  4. You can return to the Studio from the plugin screen at any time – you also get an e-mail when the materials are ready.
  5. Optionally, to let MediaAgentAI publish the articles you approve: create a user with the Author role, add an application password in its profile, and enter both in the “Publishing on this site” card on the plugin screen.
sections.faq:
Do I have to give MediaAgentAI a password?

No. The free sample materials and the articles that follow wait in MediaAgentAI Studio, where
you review them and copy them to your site yourself. An account is needed only if you want
MediaAgentAI to publish the articles you approve on your site.

Which role should the account for publishing have?

Author. MediaAgentAI can then publish and edit only its own posts, upload their images and
add tags, and it uses the post categories you already have. Accounts with the Editor,
Administrator or Shop manager role are refused, because the service does not need, and must
not get, access to the content of other users or to the administration of your site.

Why a separate account instead of my own?

So that the articles have an author of their own, access is limited to what publishing
needs, and the connection does not depend on the account of a particular person.

Does the plugin publish anything without my knowledge?

No. The free sample materials – two articles with social media posts and a short video –
are created as drafts in the Studio. Without a connected account nothing is published on your
site at all. With one, later articles also wait for your approval in the Studio, unless you
turn on automatic publishing there.

Does my site need WooCommerce?

No. On a WooCommerce shop the articles feature your products. On a site without a shop they
are based on the pages that describe your offer: the service reads them when you start and
prepares the sample materials, without a video. If the site has no such pages, the service first
looks for the offer on the whole site, which can take up to 10 minutes. If it finds nothing, we
let you know by e-mail.

How do I cut the access?

Click “Disconnect site” on the plugin screen, or deactivate the plugin – MediaAgentAI then
stops working for the site and, if you connected an account, deletes the application password
from its servers. The password itself belongs to you and stays in WordPress: revoke it in the
profile of the account, in the Application Passwords section, when you no longer need it.
Revoking it cuts the access to publishing immediately, whether or not the site has been
disconnected.

I do not use an SEO plugin. Will anything stop working?

Articles will be published normally, but without a meta description – WordPress has no
field of its own for it, the SEO plugin keeps it.

Why does connecting an account fail on a site without HTTPS?

WordPress disables application passwords outside HTTPS by default. This is a WordPress
safeguard, not a limitation of the plugin. Starting without an account works without HTTPS too.
sections.changelog:
1.5

  • Sites without a shop and without pages that describe the offer get the free materials too: the service first looks for the offer on the whole site, and lets you know by e-mail if it finds nothing.

1.4

  • After the start the plugin takes you straight to the Studio, where the free sample materials appear as soon as they are ready.
  • The Studio button on the plugin screen works while the materials are prepared, next to their progress.
  • Tested with WooCommerce 11.3.

1.3

  • Starting needs no account and no password: one click prepares the free sample materials in the Studio.
  • The plugin screen shows the progress of the sample materials and unlocks the Studio button when they are ready.
  • Publishing on the site is optional – connect an account with the Author role in the “Publishing on this site” card, whenever you want.
  • The plugin adds the REST API route /wp-json/twd-mediaagent/v1/verify, through which the service confirms that a start request came from your site.

1.2

  • New plugin screen, with its own entry in the admin menu instead of a page under Settings.
  • The application password can be shown while typing, and the instructions are more detailed.
  • The Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy are accepted on the plugin screen, before the site is connected.
  • Sites without WooCommerce get sample materials based on the pages that describe their offer.

1.1

  • MediaAgentAI Studio can be opened right after connecting. The sample materials – two articles with social media posts and a short video – are prepared there, and you get an e-mail when they are ready.
  • Sites without WooCommerce: the plugin screen says that we will first agree with you on what the articles should be based on.
  • All in One SEO is supported: the meta description of the articles is saved where All in One SEO keeps it.

1.0

  • First release.
